_doc: The audio every timing step reads. Times in timing/ are on the source take (generation 2). The human's locked master is the take plus lead_in_samples up to the cut, and the take minus offset_s (one bar) after it, measured to the sample (scripts/master_audio.py checks both). The edit's timeline is the post-filtered master without its lead-in, so edit time = take time before the cut and take time - offset_s after it. throw_end_edit_s is on the edit's timeline: the master's reverb throw after the cut, which belongs to neither side of the take.

credits._doc: The credits instrumental (human interventions 17): a Suno v6 instrumental cover (clip 70fd236d, share n2YP4Uh76eIDOVJy), post-filtered like the master. It plays under the fact card, disclosure and closing cards, starting after E25.
